Affordable Re-Rental Units
810 Fulton Owner LLC-475 Clermont Avenue

810 Fulton Owner LLC-475 Clermont Avenue

Live Where Brooklyn Lives

475 Clermont Avenue | Fort Greene–Clinton Hill

Affordable living meets one of Brooklyn's most connected and vibrant neighborhoods.


At 475 Clermont Avenue, residents are surrounded by the best of Brooklyn—Fort Greene Park, neighborhood restaurants and cafés, schools, cultural attractions, shopping and exceptional public transportation.


With the C and G subway lines nearby and Atlantic Terminal within easy reach, commuting throughout Brooklyn and Manhattan is convenient. Spend your weekends exploring Fort Greene Park, enjoying performances at BAM, attending an event at Barclays Center, or discovering the restaurants and local businesses that make Fort Greene and Clinton Hill so special.


475 Clermont isn't just a place to live—it's a place to connect, explore and call home.

Fort Greene Park

Residents can enjoy:

  • Walking and jogging
  • Open green space
  • Playgrounds
  • Dog-friendly areas
  • Community events
  • Historic landmarks
  • Weekend activities

Enjoy the green space and neighborhood atmosphere of nearby Fort Greene Park—an ideal place to walk, relax, exercise and enjoy Brooklyn's outdoors.

Schools & Higher Education

Nearby schools include:

  • P.S. 11 Purvis J. Behan
    PK–5 and approximately 0.2 miles from the property.
  • Achievement First Endeavor Charter School
    K–8 and approximately 0.2 miles away.
  • Bishop Loughlin Memorial High School
    Approximately 0.3 miles away.
  • Brooklyn Free School
    PK–12 and approximately 0.3 miles away.
  • Brooklyn Technical High School
  • Colleges

The location is particularly attractive to students and higher-education employees because it is near:


  • Pratt Institute — approximately 0.61 miles
  • St. Joseph's University, Brooklyn — approximately 0.47 miles
  • Long Island University Brooklyn — approximately 0.82 miles

﻿

Families and students benefit from convenient access to schools, colleges and universities throughout Fort Greene, Clinton Hill and central Brooklyn.
